title: 嚇
teacherNotes: Production C complete-package handoff for L297 嚇. Use the approved sentences exactly. Latest production boundary must be verified from origin/main before release; at claim time the lesson is release-integrated until L292-L296 are in production JSON. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, and Stage 4 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate. Keep frightening scenes child-appropriate: no horror, no attacks, no bullying, no gore, no labels or visible writing.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main learned chars through production JSON L289 + releaseIntegrationChars ["當","然","怕","哭","被"] + current new char 嚇
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, subtitles, or readable marks.
Frightened scenes must be preschool-safe: no horror, no gore, no attack, no bullying, no frightening monster details.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 嚇 as public/assets/lessons/L297/audio/char-u5687.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.text: 我怕狗，才會被狗叫聲嚇到。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我怕狗才會被狗叫聲嚇到
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在安全距離外看見一隻小狗，小狗叫了一聲，她因為怕狗而被狗叫聲嚇到。主角媽媽在旁邊陪伴安撫。畫面要清楚呈現怕狗、被狗叫聲嚇到；不可畫成狗攻擊人，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
兩個孩子在玩遊戲，其中一個孩子做出突然嚇人的動作，主角小女孩或另一個孩子被嚇得快哭，主角媽媽在旁邊溫和制止。畫面要清楚呈現不要嚇人、會把人嚇哭；不可畫成霸凌、恐怖或暴力攻擊，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 我被可怕的電影嚇哭了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我被可怕的電影嚇哭了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家中看電影，螢幕畫面只用模糊的暗色影像或誇張但不恐怖的怪影表示，她被可怕的電影嚇哭了，主角媽媽在旁邊安撫。不可出現電影文字、數字、字幕或標籤；不要畫真正恐怖、血腥或怪物細節。

approvedSentences.text: 我怕窗外的黑影，好嚇人。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我怕窗外的黑影好嚇人
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在室內看見窗外有黑影，黑影其實可以是樹影或普通人影，她覺得害怕、覺得好嚇人，主角媽媽在旁邊陪伴。畫面要清楚呈現窗外黑影和孩子覺得嚇人；不要畫恐怖鬼怪，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 當心地上有洞，不然會掉進去。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 當心地上有洞不然會掉進去
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽走在公園或路邊，地上有一個可見的小洞或坑洞，主角媽媽提醒她當心，不然可能掉進去。畫面要清楚呈現地上有洞、需要當心；洞要安全、不恐怖，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
